reason: The plugin is primarily an automation utility for DSH agents: it enables scheduled reminders via exposed tools, can wake an active session automatically at due time, and displays a web UI countdown panel, with local persistence of reminder state, as documented in the repository README and plugin manifest.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 智能体的插件，用于安排、查看和取消定时提醒，并在时间到达时触发后续执行，同时在网页右下角显示待处理提醒。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for agents to schedule, list, and cancel timed reminders, with automatic follow-up behavior at due time and a bottom-right web UI showing pending reminders.

capabilities: Schedules one-shot reminders with relative delays or absolute times through DSH tools
Automatically triggers follow-up agent activity when a reminder fires
Persists reminder state to local disk and restores on restart
Shows a web UI panel with pending reminders and countdowns
Exposes an API endpoint to fetch reminder data for the client panel

reasons.code: README describes model tools schedule_reminder, list_reminders, and cancel_reminder for creating and managing reminders.
README states reminders are serialized to $DSH_HOME/timer-reminders.json for persistence and re-arming after restart.
README explains timer fire behavior uses agent.followup() to wake the owning active session and continue work.
package.json declares a DSH host/client plugin package with a web client injection and bundle patch entry for web profile integration.
